translation: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh1 -
Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer1 -
Let them worship the Lord of this House,1

text: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
